messages:
sam.frontend: During the mobile onboarding run we hit a reproducible streaming parse failure in WKWebView. Emoji gets split across packets, JSON.parse throws, and reconnect sometimes duplicates final punctuation.

sam.frontend: Repro: open demo in app's WKWebView, start stream, toggle airplane mode ~2s, reconnect. ~50% repro.

sam.frontend: Snippet logs:
[recv] "{\"seq\":102,\"token\":\"Hi \\uD83D"
[recv] "\"DEVS\"}\n[parser] JSON.parse error: Unexpected token D
[client] appended: Hi �
[reconnect] last-id=none
[recv] "{\"seq\":103,\"token\":\"!\"}\n[client] appended: DEVS} !
[client] final: Hi �DEVS} !

lee.sdk: sounds like a UTF-8 surrogate split. Browser path (EventSource/polyfill) was parsing each event independently; native Swift SDK buffers by bytes and avoids this. parity gap noted.

chris.runtime: We can emit SSE id headers (Last-Event-ID) and include per-message seq so clients can dedupe on resume. But client must also buffer partial utf8 sequences.

nina: short-term workshop fix: switch demo to fetch() + reader + TextDecoder with {stream:true} so partial utf8 is handled and lines are assembled before JSON.parse. Example in docs.

lee.sdk: I'll prototype a tiny 'stream-safe-parse' helper (incremental TextDecoder, newline/json-stream framing, optional seq dedupe). We can ship it in devex and include in sample-app.

chris.runtime: opened ENG-STREAM-519 to track: runtime SSE id flag, devex helper lib, sample-app update, and tests for polyfill vs native parity.

sam.frontend: i'll try the fetch+decoder patch on device lab and report back. thanks.

devbot: Cluster note: increased EOFs detected 2026-03-24T09:11Z; linked ENG-STREAM-519.
